# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. The v4 line adds variable and color font support, animated WebP encoding, new drawing and stream APIs, and broader native-platform coverage. It also changes long-standing font, Vulkan, WebAssembly, and obsolete-API behavior, so review the migration notes before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now fail compilation** — Legacy SKPaint text/font members and paint-only text shaping overloads are now errors. Sample-count GPU constructors, run-buffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality also become errors, with the two enums removed from the reference assembly. Move text state to SKFont, use SKSamplingOptions, and use the replacement constructors and Glyphs or Positions properties. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo becomes GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the new casing; code relying on the old type's IEquatable implementation or equality operators must compare the required fields instead. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — The protected setter is removed from SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose. Derived wrappers can no longer change it after construction and should select their ownership and disposal behavior in the constructor path. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **A parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface** — new SKFont() and assigning null to SKFont.Typeface now produce SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and draws nothing. Pass SKTypeface.Default or another explicit typeface when text should use a real font, and use Typeface.IsEmpty to detect the empty face. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint.Typeface defaults to SKTypeface.Default** — A new or reset SKPaint now exposes a non-null SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Remove null-based checks for an unset paint typeface, or use IsEmpty when an empty face is the condition that matters. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Missing Android font families fall back to the default** — SKTypeface.FromFamilyName no longer returns null for an unknown family on Android; it returns SKTypeface.Default consistently with other platforms. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when application logic must distinguish a missing family. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) validates the 32-bit native range** — SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws OverflowException instead of silently truncating out-of-range offsets. Validate the value and call Move(int). ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Ganesh Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1** — GRContext.CreateVulkan now terminates the process rather than returning null when Vulkan 1.1 is unavailable. Create the Vulkan instance with API version 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same supported version; Vulkan 1.0-only systems must choose raster or another GPU backend before calling it.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative removes legacy fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Delete those assignments, replace fExtensions with fVkExtensions, and replace fFeatures with fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2; context-based instance and device ownership has no replacement.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion layout changes** — The YCbCr conversion-info struct adds Components and the GRVkYcbcrComponents type, changing its native layout. Update manual initializers, marshalling layouts, and size assumptions.
- **WebAssembly native assets require .NET 8** — Native WebAssembly assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Upgrade Blazor or Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later; older targets now receive an explicit build error. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The tizen-arm and tizen-x86 native assets are no longer shipped. Move Tizen deployments to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Assembly binding moves to version 4.148.0.0** — SkiaSharp.dll now has assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks.

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m148** — The engine update brings HDR and wide-gamut improvements, more consistent codec orientation handling, CICP color spaces, immutable-path support through SKPathBuilder, RF16 and other new color types, and upstream raster, runtime-effect, region, and filter fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Bundled codec, font, and compression libraries refreshed** — The shipped native stack moves to libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color fonts** — SKTypeface, SKFontArguments, and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, named instances, palette selection, palette overrides, and color-font capabilities, with HBColor providing the correct BGRA representation and SkiaSharp conversions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder and SKWebpEncoderFrame encode single-frame or animated WebP content from frame sequences and durations. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Memory-backed stream data access** — SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted SKData when the native stream can expose its contents directly. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Explicit sampling for surface draws** — New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions, restoring control over filtering when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Previously missing wrappers exposed** — Public APIs now cover XPS document creation options, per-resource GRContext flushing, shader-backed mask filters, and bitmap drawing with explicit sampling. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor their actual stride** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes and the correct row axis, returning the right pixels for non-square images and subsets that share a wider parent buffer. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Font fallback and variation queries hardened** — Default typeface resolution no longer crashes during Android startup, undersized variation spans are handled correctly, and SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPath finalization no longer races its builder** — Disposal skips pending-builder flushes once finalization begins, preventing a crash when SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives navigation** — An SKGLView in a MAUI TabBar retains the correct surface dimensions when it is detached and reattached, so rendering resumes after tab switches or navigation. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Windows startup reliability** — WinUI packages expose the projection assembly to .NET 9 consumers, while NanoServer uses an empty font manager instead of crashing where DirectWrite is unavailable. ([#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Native compatibility checks wait for first interop use** — The compatibility gate moves from a module initializer to the SkiaApi type initializer, letting applications register a DllImportResolver or adjust native search paths before libSkiaSharp is loaded. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic assets added** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now ship linux-bionic native assets for x64 and arm64 environments. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen moves to 64-bit targets** — Native packages add tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 support while retiring the EOL 32-bit Tizen assets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple target frameworks realigned** — Library packages use the base 26.0 platform version, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement for consumers. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **Linux native compatibility refreshed** — Updated cross-compilation sysroots lower the glibc ceiling for x64, x86, and arm64 assets while preserving musl and Android compatibility. ([#4062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4062))

## Security

- **libexpat security hardening** — The bundled XML parser moves to libexpat 2.8.1, including upstream security hardening. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp moves from 8.3.1.5 to 14.2.0 with variable-font and color-palette APIs, the HBColor value type and SkiaSharp color conversions, plus new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Moves to Skia m148 with RF16 and upstream correctness fixes, promotes legacy paint APIs to errors, and makes SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose read-only.
